verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a broad API surface covering voice, SMS/MMS, team messaging, video, fax, data, and system configuration, including call handling rules, forwarding, call logs, and event subscriptions, plus SDKs in several languages. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates parity with the UI. Some API resources also depend on restricted scopes that need support approval, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity claim or coverage matrix, evidence that admin features (cost centers, custom roles) are API-accessible, a public machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of coverage depth.
